_status: PROPOSED - NOT APPROVED. Draft wording for Lucindha's review (Phase 2, 10 November 2026; community and media wording added the same day). Prices and services are copied from the live website (tools/build_accounting.py); the footer is copied from the live Stage 1 acknowledgement. Nothing here may be used outside automated tests until Lucindha confirms every line and 'approved' is set to true by her decision.

community._note: No fees are published for community work, so drafts never state a fee, a date, availability or a booking. They only ask questions.

Public Speaking.question: Is there a particular topic or theme you'd like me to speak about?

Workshops.question: Which workshop topic are you interested in, for example Deaf awareness or an introduction to BSL?

I'm not sure yet.question: What kind of activity did you have in mind? It doesn't need to be decided yet.

sentences.opening: Thank you for getting in touch about {services}. I'd like to understand a bit more about what you have in mind.
commonQuestions: Who is it for, roughly how many people, and what age group?
What are you hoping it will achieve?
Which date or dates are you considering, and how long would it be?
Where would it take place, or would it be online?
What communication and access arrangements are planned or available, for example BSL interpreters, live captions, a hearing loop or step-free access?
Is this a paid engagement, a possible collaboration, or a request for voluntary support? If there's a budget, it would help to know it.
sentences.fees: If there would be a fee, I'll confirm it in writing once I know more about what's involved, including any preparation and travel.
sentences.noCommitment: Once I have these details, I'll check whether I'm able to help and let you know. Nothing is booked until we've both agreed the details in writing.
sentences.closing: I look forward to hearing from you.

media._note: Only for 'Something else' enquiries that clearly come from the media and don't touch on personal history or health (those go to you).

sentences.opening: Thank you for getting in touch about a possible media feature.
sentences.questionsLead: So I can consider your request, could you tell me:
questions: Which publication, programme or channel is it for, and in what format (for example print, online, TV, radio or podcast)?
What is the topic or angle, and what would you like me to talk about?
When and where would it take place, and what is your deadline?
What communication arrangements will be in place, for example a BSL interpreter or questions in writing?
sentences.pressPage: Background information and short biographies are on my media page at www.lucindhalawson.co.uk/media.html.
sentences.noCommitment: Once I have these details, I'll let you know whether I'm able to take part. Nothing is agreed until I've confirmed it in writing.
sentences.closing: Thank you again for thinking of me.
